vibe: Spiritual, earthy, contemplative, trustworthy, mystical but modern

spacing_and_layout.philosophy: Generous spacing for breathing room and contemplation. Avoid dense layouts.

buttons.primary: Solid #2C3531 background, #F9F6F0 text, 16px border-radius. TouchableOpacity with subtle scale on press.

inputs.style: Flushed or subtle bottom-bordered TextInput for a classic, diary-like entry feel. Use placeholder text in #89A894.
inputs.behavior: Guided step-by-step 4-stage form (Personal -> Health -> Ancestry -> Spirituality). Wrap in KeyboardAvoidingView and ScrollView.

cards.style: Flat, pure white (#FFFFFF) or extremely light beige, 1px border (#DCD5C6), NO heavy shadows, extremely soft ambient shadow if necessary (elevation: 2).

mind_map_visualization.layout: Radial or Vertical Hierarchical. Center node is the User.
mind_map_visualization.maternal_branch: Nodes and connecting strokes in #C87971 (Terracotta) tones.
mind_map_visualization.paternal_branch: Nodes and connecting strokes in #4F6D7A (Slate Blue) tones.
mind_map_visualization.node_design: Circle or rounded-rectangle with soft #F9F6F0 background, 2px border in branch color, icon or initials in center. Clickable via TouchableWithoutFeedback.
mind_map_visualization.interaction: Tapping a node opens a bottom sheet (BottomSheetModal) revealing diseases, vows, events, and spiritual causes.

media_and_images.philosophy: Use subtle, high-quality spiritual and organic textures. Avoid literal meditative clichés.

image_urls.description: Minimalist modern Islamic geometric pattern background in warm sand and bone-white. Use as extremely low opacity (10%) View background for spiritual screens.
Ancestral tree illustration for stage 3 of onboarding (Family/Ancestry).
Spiritual healing illustration for stage 4 of onboarding (Spirituality & Vows).
Vintage parchment texture. Can be blended into the mind map background for a 'historical record' aesthetic.

testing.instructions: All interactive elements, inputs, and mind-map nodes MUST include a testID (React Native equivalent of data-testid) for automated testing. Example: testID='onboarding-next-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY React Native components (View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, TextInput). DO NOT use HTML elements.
For the 4-stage data entry, implement a progressive wizard flow with a top progress bar. Don't overwhelm the user with all fields at once.

For the Mind Map, use react-native-svg to draw the connections and nodes, and wrap it in a gesture handler for pan/zoom. Ensure maternal nodes are styled with maternal_primary and paternal with paternal_primary.
Always apply testID to interactive elements for testing.
Avoid standard tech gradients and AI purple. Rely on solid earthy tones, minimal borders, and generous padding.
